text:
glasses_omar: Highly variable. Missed nightstand_b1 (07:00) and coffee_table_l1 (10:08, 21:35). Do not assume it stays in the bathroom or bedroom. Check coffee_table_l1, nightstand_b1, and desk_b1.

mug_omar: Erratically moves between kitchen and living room. Missed kitchen_table_k1 (07:39) and coffee_table_l1 (10:00, 13:03, 20:30). Do not assume it is in the cupboard or on the desk. Check coffee_table_l1 and kitchen_table_k1.

water_bottle_omar: Moves between kitchen and living room. Missed coffee_table_l1 (13:30) and kitchen_table_k1 (19:26). Do not assume it is in the dish rack or on the desk. Check coffee_table_l1 and kitchen_table_k1.

charger_omar: Missed coffee_table_l1 (10:22) after assuming bed_b1. It is not always in the bedroom. Check coffee_table_l1, entry_floor_e1, and entry_hook_e1.

book_omar: Missed coffee_table_l1 (13:03) after assuming couch_l1. It is not always on the couch. Check coffee_table_l1 and bed_b1.

General: Coffee_table_l1 is the most frequent location for Omar’s items (glasses, mug, water bottle, charger, book). Do not assume items are in the kitchen, bedroom, or on the desk. Always check coffee_table_l1 first for Omar’s personal items. Avoid assuming fixed locations for mugs, water bottles, or glasses.
